questions.question: First apply filter_subcategories(subcategories_to_remove=[Clothing]). Then apply sort_bars(order=descending). In the Electronics-only view, which regions lead the pack and how wide is the gap between first and second place?

answer.value: Electronics sales rank East first (about 1300), North second (about 1200), then West and South—the top two are only ~100 units apart, but both sit well above the bottom half of the list, so the chart reads as a tight race at the top with a clearer drop toward the South.

key_insights: Removing Clothing leaves a clean Electronics-only comparison across regions.
East narrowly beats North; the sorted bars make that ordering and the ~100-point gap obvious.

reasoning.reasoning: Strip Clothing so regional bars reflect Electronics revenue only.
Descending sort lines regions up from strongest Electronics sales downward.
